content: वन् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (वनति) .²1 To honour, worship. .²2 To aid. .²3 To sound. .²4 To be occupied or engaged. --II. €8 <ab>U.</ab> (वनोति, वनुते, usually वनुते only) .²1 To beg, ask, request (said to govern two <ab>acc.</ab>); तोयदादितरं नैव चातको वनुते जलम्. .²2 To seek for, seek to obtain. .²3 To conquer, possess. .²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> To like, love. .²5 To wish, desire. .²6 To make ready, prepare for. .²7 To hurt, injure. --III. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (वनति, वानयति-ते) .²1 To favour, aid. .²2 To hurt, injure. .²3 To sound. .²4 To confide in.
